name: Wall Mounted Cereal Dispenser | 1.5L Transparent Grain Storage Container | One-Touch Cereal & Rice Dispenser | Space Saving Kitchen Organizer
description:
Keep your kitchen neat and organized with the Wall Mounted Dry Food Dispenser. Designed with a 1.5L large capacity, this transparent storage container is perfect for storing cereals, rice, grains, oats, beans, lentils, candy, pet food, and other dry ingredients. Its wall-mounted design helps save valuable countertop space, while the one-touch dispensing button allows quick, mess-free access to food. Made from durable food-grade ABS material, the dispenser features a sealed lid that helps keep contents fresh, dry, and protected from moisture. The transparent body makes it easy to monitor food levels, making it an ideal storage solution for modern kitchens.

Key Features
1.5L large capacity dry food storage container
Wall-mounted design saves kitchen counter space
One-touch button for quick and mess-free dispensing
Transparent body for easy food level monitoring
Airtight lid helps keep food fresh and moisture-free
Suitable for cereals, rice, grains, beans, oats, candy, and pet food
Durable food-grade ABS construction
Easy to install, refill, and clean
Compact and modern design for organized storage
Ideal for home kitchens, pantries, and laundry storage

Product Type: Wall Mounted Dry Food Dispenser
Capacity: 1.5 Liters
Material: Food-Grade ABS Plastic
Mounting Type: Wall Mounted
Color: Random / As Available
Suitable For: Dry Food & Grain Storage

How to Use
Install the dispenser securely on a clean wall surface
Open the lid and fill with dry food items
Close the lid tightly to maintain freshness
Press the dispensing button to release the desired amount
Refill and clean regularly for hygienic use

Material / Composition
Food-Grade ABS Plastic
Transparent Plastic Storage Chamber
Moisture-Resistant Sealing Components

Safety Information
Store only dry food items
Keep away from direct heat and flames
Clean thoroughly before first use
Do not overload beyond recommended capacity
Keep out of reach of young children during installation
